title: NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1: long-term monthly means of geopotential height, 1991–2020, at 17 pressure levels
provider: NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory (PSL), Boulder, Colorado, from the NCEP/NCAR Reanalysis 1 (NOAA NCEP and NSF NCAR); served by PSL's THREDDS Data Server

climatology.time: month of the year, January to December, dated in the year 1 (hours since 1800-01-01)

stride.description: take every stride-th point of the 2.5° grid

ltm.description: The whole 2.5° grid, 144 × 73 points, 17 levels from 1000 to 10 hPa, 12 months (about 9 MB)

format: netCDF classic, one file: hgt (time 12, level 17, lat 73, lon 144), float32, geopotential metres. Latitude from 90 to -90, longitude from 0 to 357.5 E. Each month is the mean over 1991–2020 of that month's monthly means of the reanalysis, analysed four times a day.
coverage: Global, 2.5° grid; the normal year of 1991–2020
use: The climatology against which data/products/verification.py forms anomalies of 500 hPa height for the anomaly correlation, interpolated linearly in time between the months' middles.
licence: Public domain (US Government work); PSL asks that use be acknowledged: "NCEP-NCAR Reanalysis 1 data provided by the NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA, from their website at https://psl.noaa.gov"
citation: Kalnay, E., M. Kanamitsu, R. Kistler, W. Collins, D. Deaven, L. Gandin, M. Iredell, S. Saha, G. White, J. Woollen, Y. Zhu, M. Chelliah, W. Ebisuzaki, W. Higgins, J. Janowiak, K. C. Mo, C. Ropelewski, J. Wang, A. Leetmaa, R. Reynolds, R. Jenne and D. Joseph (1996), The NCEP/NCAR 40-Year Reanalysis Project, Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc. 77, 437–471.
